films.title: 2.6 Seconds: Death in the Outback
films.genre: Documentary / Aboriginal + Indigenous / Crime / Biography + History
films.synopsis: A gripping, cinematic documentary series that reconstructs one of Australia’s defining contemporary events, exposing the enduring legacies of race, justice, and colonial policing.

films.title: A Common Story
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature / Romance
films.synopsis: Starring Alba Rohrwacher (Three Goodbyes, TIFF ’25) and Guido Caprino, writer-director Anna Foglietta’s heartfelt debut feature follows nascent empty nesters who encounter old desires while seeking new meaning in their lives.

films.title: A Girl Unknown
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Drama / Directed by Women / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: In Zou Jing’s assured debut, Cao Ruofan and Li Gengxi (Bi Gan’s Resurrection) portray a girl passed through three different families and identities under China’s one-child policy. Visually refined, this affecting coming-of-age drama explores resilience and self-determination.

films.title: A Good Little Soldier
films.genre: Drama
films.synopsis: In Stéphane Brizé’s latest capitalist critique, Carla (Alba Rohrwacher) is pushed to her moral limits when she is recruited to rebrand a company’s image, compromising people for profit to serve her corporate supervisors.

films.title: A Long Winter
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Adaptation / Drama / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming. From Andrew Haigh, the acclaimed director of All of Us Strangers.

films.title: A Talent for Murder
films.genre: Adaptation / Biography + History / Crime / Drama / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: This smouldering chamber thriller from Anton Corbijn (Control) stars Oscar winner Helen Mirren and Alden Ehrenreich (Fair Play) as opponents in a strange confrontation between a youthful literary agent and The Talented Mr. Ripley author Patricia Highsmith.

films.title: After Elena
films.genre: Drama / Comedy / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: When a family's matriarch dies, four relatives are forced to confront decades of silence, resentment, and buried affection. Led by Alfredo Castro, this sharp ensemble balances humour and melancholy in a moving portrait of grief and reconciliation.

films.title: Ah Girl
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature / Coming of Age / Family Friendly
films.synopsis: Winner of the Youth Jury Award at the 55th International Film Festival Rotterdam, Ang Geck Geck Priscilla’s feature debut is a bittersweet yet heartwarming story of a young girl as she tries to figure out what it means to become an adult.

films.title: Alice: Pioneer of Cinema
films.genre: Films About Film / Biography + History / Drama / Canadian
films.synopsis: Amidst the advent of modern cinema, trailblazing artist Alice Guy becomes the first woman film director in this lush historical series starring Academy Award–nominee Bérénice Bejo (The Artist).

films.title: All About Corinne
films.genre: Comedy / Drama
films.synopsis: Paris Follies writer-director Marc Fitoussi re-teams with the inimitable, Oscar-nominated Isabelle Huppert (TIFF ’16’s Elle) for this delectable comedy about a veteran background actor who spies a belated chance to break into the fickle family of le cinéma français.

films.title: All of a Sudden
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Drama
films.synopsis: Ryûsuke Hamaguchi brings Virginie Efira and Tao Okamoto together in a poignant drama about friendship, illness, art, and the responsibilities of care, creating a film that makes the world seem gentler, more open, and more humane.

films.title: All That She Wants
films.genre: Comedy / Romance / Canadian
films.synopsis: Annie Murphy (Schitt’s Creek) stars in this effervescent, tender-hearted, refreshingly modern rom-com that chronicles a casual encounter between a millennial and a Gen Zer — and the life-altering consequences that result.

films.title: Alpha Gang
films.genre: Cult / Science Fiction + Fantasy / Comedy / War / Music
films.synopsis: Léa Seydoux, Dave Bautista, Lily-Rose Depp, and Cate Blanchett star in the Zellner brothers’ look at an alien gang coming to Earth to conquer, but finding the human world has a plague they weren’t ready for.

films.title: Always Lalisa
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Documentary / Music / Directed by Women / Family Friendly
films.synopsis: K-pop idol–turned–global superstar Lisa stars in this intimate and transformative documentary tracing her journey from childhood ambition through BLACKPINK stardom into the artist she is today.

films.title: American Hostage
films.genre: Biography + History / Crime / Drama / Adaptation
films.synopsis: Jon Hamm stars in this adaptation of the hit podcast, which tells the true story of an Indianapolis radio reporter thrust into a high-stakes situation when a local man takes a bank employee hostage and demands to be interviewed live on air.

films.title: Ancestors
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Drama / First Feature / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: A haunting journey set in 1980s London, David Turpin’s mesmerizing debut transforms one young man’s search for a missing friend into an unforgettable story of love, loss, and gay legacy.

films.title: Anchors Aweigh
films.genre: Comedy / Cult / Romance / Films About Film / Documentary
films.synopsis: After a thwarted marriage proposal, alt-comedian Matt Barats spirals into an existential crisis in this semi-autobiographical blend of deadpan absurdism and unexpected poignancy told in a first-person, confessional style à la Ross McElwee or John Wilson.

films.title: Angh
films.genre: Aboriginal + Indigenous / Biography + History / Drama / First Feature
films.synopsis: In a deserted Nagaland village in the early 1960s, a chief must choose between his family and a transforming world embodied by an incoming American missionary in filmmaker Theja Rio’s gripping feature-length adaptation of his award-winning 2021 short.

films.title: Arne Goes to Space
films.section: Discovery, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Comedy / Science Fiction + Fantasy / First Feature / Cult
films.synopsis: An extraterrestrial visitor upends the lives of two elderly brothers in northern Sweden in Lars Vega’s disarming blend of sci-fi fable and small-town comedy.

films.title: Arrested Memory
films.genre: Crime / Comedy / Action + Adventure / Romance
films.synopsis: A seasoned detective (Ethan Juan) recently diagnosed with dementia is doggedly pursued by both cops and crooks after he unwittingly wanders off with a multimillion-dollar ransom in a new absurdist crime caper from cult auteur SABU.

films.title: Ashes
films.genre: Drama / Latin American Cultures / Adaptation
films.synopsis: Diego Luna crafts a powerful and deeply humane portrait of the immigrant experience through the eyes of a young woman forced to rebuild her life in a new country, delivering a nuanced exploration of family, identity, belonging, and displacement.

films.title: At Night
films.genre: First Feature / Experimental + Avant-Garde / Directed by Women / 2SLGBTQ+
films.synopsis: Mesmerizing and melancholic, the much-anticipated debut feature by British filmmaker and artist Beatrice Gibson is a work of choral autofiction that shifts from narrative to documentary to dream over a single night in Paris, reflecting on the nature of womanhood, privilege, and solidarity.

films.title: Atonement
films.genre: Drama / War / Middle Eastern Cultures / Biography + History
films.synopsis: Boyd Holbrook (The Bikeriders), Hiam Abbass (TIFF ’25’s Palestine 36), and Oscar winner Kenneth Branagh star in Oscar-nominated writer-director Reed Van Dyk’s searing story of trauma and forgiveness following a horrifying event during the Iraq War.

films.title: Ba's Book
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Biography + History / Directed by Women / Documentary / Films About Film / Canadian
films.synopsis: In a hybrid documentary retelling, documentary filmmaker Ashley Duong takes her father’s memoir and stages a recreation of it in Vietnam alongside her family.

films.title: Babies
films.genre: Comedy / Drama / Directed by Women / Romance
films.synopsis: Seth Rogen and Oscar nominee Anna Kendrick (TIFF ’09’s Up in the Air) star in Lauren Miller Rogen’s big-hearted comedy about the dilemma that eventually infiltrates every long-term relationship: to parent or not to parent?

films.title: Back in Black
films.genre: Comedy / Crime / Canadian
films.synopsis: Christopher Walken leads a terrific cast in director Ron Murphy’s hilarious satire about a failing family funeral home that experiences a reversal of fortune thanks to their town’s suspicious spike in fatality rates.

films.title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: The latest from prolific maestro Takashi Miike, like Abel Ferrara’s Bad Lieutenant (TIFF ’92) and Werner Herzog’s Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call — New Orleans (TIFF ’09), is a sensational ride through the darkest crevasses of the criminal underworld.

films.title: Bedford Park
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature / Asian Cultures / Romance
films.synopsis: Writer-director Stephanie Ahn’s feature debut explores the complexities of diasporic experience through a chance encounter between two thirtysomething, second-generation Korean Americans, tracking their relationship as it moves from circumstantial to friendly to romantic.

films.title: Being Heumann
films.genre: Biography + History / Drama / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Featuring a breakout performance by Ruth Madeley and Oscar nominee Mark Ruffalo (TIFF ’15’s Spotlight), this inspiring historical drama from Oscar-winning filmmaker Siân Heder (CODA) celebrates the paradigm-shifting activist Judy Heumann, “Mother of the Disability Rights Movement.”

films.title: Below
films.genre: Horror / Mystery + Thriller / Canadian
films.synopsis: Something monstrous lurks off the coast in this suspenseful, Newfoundland-set limited series, starring Josh Hartnett (Trap) and Mackenzie Davis (Station Eleven).

films.title: Ben'Imana
films.genre: Directed by Women / Black + African Diaspora / First Feature / Drama
films.synopsis: In this powerful, feminist debut feature, which won the Caméra d’Or at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, Marie-Clémentine Dusabejambo brilliantly explores the issue of forgiveness in the wake of the Tutsi genocide in Rwanda.

films.title: Bitter Christmas
films.genre: Drama / Comedy / Films About Film / 2SLGBTQ+
films.synopsis: With noirish hues and telenovela twists, the latest from Oscar-winning maestro Pedro Almodóvar (TIFF ’24’s The Room Next Door) follows a pair of self-centred film directors exploring grief, love, and the perils of unchecked artistic license.

films.title: Black Sunflowers
films.genre: Documentary / War / Music
films.synopsis: Black Sunflowers is a mosaic of Ukrainian youth, shuttling between the frontlines and civilian life, captured by the gifted American filmmaker James Marcus Haney (No Cameras Allowed) collaborating with an esteemed Ukrainian crew.

films.title: Bleeding Hearts
films.genre: Documentary / Music / Romance
films.synopsis: This real-life love story follows the charismatic musicians Zella Day and Jesse Woods as they team to create the alt-country band Chaparelle with collaborator Beau Bedford, in a documentary with as much drama as a season of Nashville.

films.title: Blindspot Berlin
films.genre: Crime / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: This gripping thriller depicts the investigation — and its shortfalls — in the months before the December 2016 attack at the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz, Berlin.

films.title: Brace Your Heart
films.genre: Aboriginal + Indigenous / Directed by Women / Drama / Romance
films.synopsis: Amanda Kernell’s luminous third drama is a richly observed portrait of love, resilience, and the enduring strength of Sámi women in northernmost Europe.

films.title: Bucking Fastard
films.genre: Drama / Romance / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: Director Werner Herzog and real-life sisters Kate and Rooney Mara enliven the story of siblings who speak as one, fall in love with the same person, and eventually spiral.

films.title: Bunker
films.genre: Drama / Mystery + Thriller / Romance
films.synopsis: Oscar winners Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem play a couple whose bond is tested when a mysterious billionaire’s proposal prompts an ethical impasse in the latest from Oscar-winning writer-director Florian Zeller (TIFF ’20’s The Father).

films.title: Carrie
films.genre: Horror / Adaptation / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: Vanguard of character-driven horror Mike Flanagan (Life of Chuck, TIFF ’24) returns to episodic storytelling with this kinetic adaptation of Stephen King’s classic novel, about the cruelty faced by a sheltered young girl entering high school.

films.title: Cheyenne
films.section: TIFF Docs, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Sports / Western
films.synopsis: Cheyenne follows a group of fearless cowgirls who compete at riding wild broncos on the rodeo circuit after nearly a century of being excluded because of their gender.

films.title: Children Untold
films.genre: War / Directed by Women / Drama / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: Acclaimed filmmaker and author Miwa Nishikawa adapts her forthcoming novel into a compassionate and clear-eyed postwar drama about a 12-year-old orphan who disguises herself as a boy, featuring a striking performance by newcomer Ami Koyae and a memorable supporting turn by Koji Yakusho.

films.title: City Lights
films.genre: Romance / Comedy / Drama
films.synopsis: City Lights is a 1931 American synchronized sound romantic comedy-drama film written, produced, directed by, and starring Charlie Chaplin. While the film has no audible dialog, it was released with a synchronized musical score with sound effects. The story follows the misadventures of Chaplin's Tramp as he falls in love with a blind woman (Virginia Cherrill) and develops a turbulent friendship with an alcoholic millionaire (Harry Myers).

films.title: Clarissa
films.genre: Black + African Diaspora / Adaptation / Romance / Drama
films.synopsis: Led by a stellar cast including Sophie Okonedo and David Oyelowo, filmmaking brothers Arie and Chuko Esiri’s second feature is a beguiling adaptation of Virginia Woolf’s Mrs. Dalloway set in contemporary Lagos.

films.title: Closing Night
films.genre: Drama / First Feature / Comedy / Canadian
films.synopsis: Naomi Watts, Sarah Paulson, and Odessa A’zion deliver powerhouse performances in Cody Fern’s sensational feature debut, where a hardened movie star reunites with the deliciously messy family she left behind decades earlier.

films.title: Club Kid
films.genre: Comedy / Drama / 2SLGBTQ+
films.synopsis: In his exuberant debut feature, writer-director Jordan Firstman stars as a carousing New York City club promoter whose lifestyle is upended by the unexpected responsibility of raising a 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

films.title: Congo Boy
films.country: Central African Republic, France, Democratic Republic of Congo, Italy
films.genre: Music / Drama / Black + African Diaspora / War
films.synopsis: Drawing upon director Rafiki Fariala’s own experience as a displaced Congolese finding purpose in art, this rousing character study follows a young man trying to care for his family while forging his own path as a rapper in Bangui.

films.title: Conversation With The Sea
films.genre: Middle Eastern Cultures / Drama
films.synopsis: Condemned to pay the social security contributions owed by his son, a father (Kamel El Basha) desperately tries to prove his death in the moving drama Conversation With The Sea.

films.title: Coward
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Drama / War / Biography + History
films.synopsis: Belgian director Lukas Dhont’s poignant third feature celebrates a love that blooms amid the hardships and horrors of the First World War.

films.title: CRE[AI]TE: New Voices in AI Filmmaking
films.synopsis: Join CapCut at TIFF for a special screening showcasing standout films from the first-ever CRE[AI]TE, CapCut’s global AI festival bringing together creators and filmmakers from around the world to explore new possibilities in storytelling.

films.title: Crystal Lake
films.genre: Horror
films.synopsis: Set long before the events of Friday the 13th, Linda Cardellini stars as Pamela Voorhees in this captivating, A24-produced origin series.

films.title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
films.genre: Documentary / Music / Biography + History / Black + African Diaspora / Canadian
films.synopsis: Stars like Bruce Springsteen, Cher, and Dionne Warwick sing the praises of an underappreciated musical icon in this high-spirited and warm-hearted portrait from Canadian director Barry Avrich (Oscar Peterson: Black + White, TIFF ’21).

films.title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Drama / Adaptation
films.synopsis: This captivating adaptation of Jun’ichirō Tanizaki’s novel from director Wayne Wang (TIFF ’93’s The Joy Luck Club) follows an aging widower drawn into an unnervingly intimate relationship with his caregiver daughter-in-law.

films.title: Djinn Wedding
films.genre: Drama / Mystery + Thriller / Middle Eastern Cultures
films.synopsis: Set in a remote Anatolian village, Ferit Karahan’s Djinn Wedding is an impressive family drama that unravels family secrets and conflicts across three periods of time.

films.title: Dorothy
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Drama / Romance / Asian Cultures
films.synopsis: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

films.title: Double Freedom
films.country: Chile, Argentina, Luxembourg, Germany, United Kingdom
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Latin American Cultures / Drama
films.synopsis: Less follow-up or sequel to his breakout debut than a sly and clever echo, Lisandro Alonso’s graceful and extraordinarily beautiful Double Freedom returns us to the daily life of Misael, a solitary labourer in Argentina’s rural La Pampa.

films.title: Drifter
films.genre: Drama / Sports / First Feature
films.synopsis: Fast & Furious alum Sung Kang directs and stars in this alternately melancholy and exhilarating character study of a lonesome racetrack custodian with a secret talent for drifting.

films.title: Edward Said: Between Worlds
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Biography + History / Middle Eastern Cultures
films.synopsis: Palestinian scholar Edward Said is profiled in his own words, drawing upon decades of archives, to explore the legacy of his groundbreaking works including Orientalism and The Question of Palestine.

films.title: Eklipse
films.genre: Coming of Age / Drama / First Feature
films.synopsis: As the highly anticipated 1999 solar eclipse comes and goes, everything that was shrouded in darkness suddenly comes to light in Eklipse, the feature-length debut of Austrian writer-director Manuel Wetscher, whose penchant for poetic realism brings emotional turbulence to a bucolic setting.

films.title: Elephants in the Fog
films.genre: Drama / Asian Cultures
films.synopsis: A village matriarch (Puspa Thing Lama) must choose between her heart’s desires and her duty to her community when a young woman disappears into the forest in this delicate, riveting thriller.

films.title: Elsinore
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Biography + History / Drama
films.synopsis: Andrew Scott (TIFF ’25’s Blue Moon and Wake Up Dead Man) delivers his strongest performance honouring the real-life story of Ian Charleson, the Chariots of Fire actor who courageously pushed through AIDS to play Hamlet at London’s National Theatre.

films.title: Everest: The Other Side
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Action + Adventure / Sports
films.synopsis: Professional ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson seek to ski down the North Face of Mount Everest, a feat never achieved, as the Oscar-winning filmmakers Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin (Free Solo, TIFF ’18) follow their journey, shooting for the IMAX screen.

films.title: Everybody Wants to F*ck Me
films.genre: Comedy / Mystery + Thriller / First Feature
films.synopsis: Taron Egerton gives a gleefully committed performance as a man determined to be viewed by potential paramours as the ideal catch in director Jonathan Schey’s darkly comic appraisal of modern dating and how some men signal virtues they don’t possess.

films.title: Everything Else is Noise
films.genre: Latin American Cultures / Comedy / Experimental + Avant-Garde
films.synopsis: Prolific Mexican-Canadian auteur Nicolás Pereda has delivered his sharpest and most amusing film yet with Everything Else is Noise, a sly, self-reflexive comedy of manners and mishaps involving a trio of women classical composers and musicians.

films.title: Everytime
films.genre: Drama / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: A grieving mother and her late daughter’s boyfriend explore questions of guilt, grief, and forgiveness on a family holiday, in Sandra Wollner’s bold and haunting Un Certain Regard winner.

films.title: Evil Genius
films.genre: Biography + History / Crime / Drama / Romance
films.synopsis: Featuring David Harbour (Stranger Things) and Oscar winner Patricia Arquette (Boyhood), Courteney Cox’s second feature as director boldly dramatizes the chilling, darkly hilarious web of stories behind 2003’s infamous “pizza bomber” incident.

films.title: Faith
films.genre: Drama
films.synopsis: The spark of romance offers a hard-working single mother (Erin Doherty, The Crown) the chance to imagine a different future. But after tragedy strikes, she discovers that the man she may be falling for (James McAvoy) is hiding a truth she couldn’t have imagined.

films.title: Fjord
films.genre: Drama
films.synopsis: Winner of the prestigious Palme d’Or at this year’s Cannes Film Festival, the latest from writer-director Cristian Mungiu is a gripping high-stakes courtroom drama driven by a profound moral dilemma.

films.title: Flies
films.genre: Drama / Coming of Age / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: When a lonely woman rents a room to a father with a hospitalized relative, she forms an unexpected bond with his young son, in Fernando Eimbcke’s tender story about care, connection, and quiet transformation.

films.title: Four Seasons in Java
films.country: Indonesia, France, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Saudi Arabia, Singapore
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / Crime / Environment + Sustainability
films.synopsis: Kamila Andini, the brilliant mind behind TIFF ’21 Platform Award winner Yuni, returns with another polished and picturesque film with a strong women's narrative, starring Indonesia’s biggest talents Putri Marino, Christine Hakim, and Arya Saloka.

films.title: Freaky Friday
films.genre: Comedy / Science Fiction + Fantasy / Family Friendly

films.title: Furies
films.genre: Action + Adventure / First Feature / Middle Eastern Cultures / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: Set in a bankrupt and sweaty Beirut, Rami Kodeih’s impressive thriller follows two sisters in need of money for an important surgery.

films.title: Future Tense
films.genre: Science Fiction + Fantasy / Environment + Sustainability / Romance
films.synopsis: With Future Tense, Jenna Cato Bass deals with climate change, human guilt, and South Africa’s identity in this bold time-lapse story based in the near future.

films.title: Gail
films.section: TIFF Docs, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Documentary / Music / Canadian
films.synopsis: This music documentary on an Our Lady Peace superfan follows her on the band’s 30th anniversary Canadian tour, and boasts an original score by Lesley Barber (Bonjour Tristesse, TIFF ’24), and orchestral arrangements by Eric Rosse (Tori Amos’ Little Earthquakes).

films.title: Gentle Monster
films.genre: Crime / Drama / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Featuring emotional performances from Léa Seydoux (TIFF ’25’s Silent Friend) and Jella Haase, writer-director Marie Kreutzer’s follow-up to TIFF ’22’s Corsage is a dual portrait of women trapped in moral maelstroms caused by men’s malfeasance.

films.title: Girl Group
films.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
films.genre: Comedy / Music / Musical / Coming of Age / Directed by Women / 2SLGBTQ+
films.synopsis: Rebel Wilson writes, directs, and stars in this story of a pop star who, following a downward spiral, finds a new sense of purpose by assembling a bunch of young up-and-comers to form a group of their own.

films.title: Glaxo
films.genre: Adaptation / Drama / Biography + History / Crime
films.synopsis: Glaxo, Benjamín Naishtat’s riveting adaptation of Hernán Ronsino’s novel, transforms a single betrayal into an absorbing tale of guilt, loyalty, and memory, weaving personal tragedy with Argentina’s turbulent twentieth-century history through an atmosphere of mounting mystery and suspense.

films.title: God Bless You, Mr Kopu
films.genre: Aboriginal + Indigenous / Action + Adventure / Crime / Drama / First Feature
films.synopsis: A charismatic salesman promises wealth, success, and a fresh start — but at what cost? Alex Liu's wildly entertaining debut blends dark comedy, social satire, and a propulsive thriller into a sharp exploration of ambition and identity.

films.title: Growth of the Soil
films.genre: Drama / Adaptation / Romance / Biography + History
films.synopsis: Nobel Prize-winner Knut Hamsun’s novel about a farmer’s struggles in early 20th-century Norway gets a powerful and richly textured adaptation by director Hans Petter Moland and his superb cast.

films.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
films.genre: Drama / Romance / Asian Cultures / Music
films.synopsis: Oscar nominee Rinko Kikuchi (TIFF ’06’s Babel) stars in this fantasy-fuelled fable from director Josef Kubota Wladyka (Catch the Fair One), which follows a Tokyo ballroom enthusiast as she dreams and dances her way through spells of bliss and sorrow.

films.title: HALF
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Horror / Music / Western
films.synopsis: Twin half-blooded vampires (Ranjith Sajeev and Aiswarya Raj) wage war with desert highway hijackers in a gory martial arts curry western from writer-director Samjad and choreographer Very Tri Yulisman (The Raid 2, The Night Comes for Us).

films.title: Happily Ever After
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Drama / Directed by Women / Family Friendly / 2SLGBTQ+
films.synopsis: American Girl director Feng-I Fiona Roan’s sophomore film explores the definition of happiness through the lens of two sisters, backed by breakout performances from Xuan Chen and singer-turned-actress Shuhua Yeh of i-dle.

films.title: Head to Head
films.genre: Directed by Women / First Feature / Comedy
films.synopsis: Iranian filmmaker Ghasideh Golmakani’s absurd and sharply satirical debut feature explores what happens when a female director forces male actors to wear skirts and headscarves.

films.title: Hombre al agua
films.genre: Drama / Films About Film / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: The latest directorial feature from Gael García Bernal (TIFF ’19’s Chicuarotes) is a psychologically astute comedy of manners for the modern age, following an ensemble of eclectic characters seeking to become something more than who they are.

films.title: Hoosiers
films.genre: Sports / Drama
films.synopsis: Hoosiers (released in some countries as Best Shot) is a 1986 American sports drama film written by Angelo Pizzo and directed by David Anspaugh in his feature directorial debut. It tells the story of a small-town Indiana high school basketball team and its journey to the state championship finals. It is inspired in part by the Milan High School team who won the 1954 state championship against Muncie Central High School. Gene Hackman stars as Norman Dale, a new coach with a spotty past. The film co-stars Barbara Hershey and Dennis Hopper, whose role as the basketball-loving town drunk earned him an Academy Award nomination.

films.title: Hope
films.genre: Mystery + Thriller / Science Fiction + Fantasy / Action + Adventure / Horror
films.synopsis: In this madcap marvel from Na Hong-jin (The Chaser, The Wailing), a police chief (Hwang Jung-min) and deputy (Hoyeon) investigate a monstrous incursion upon their remote village, as a headstrong local (Zo In-sung) musters a hunting party to root out the threat.

films.title: How We Stand
films.genre: Drama / Aboriginal + Indigenous / Directed by Women / Adaptation / Biography + History
films.synopsis: How We Stand combines magical realism, a story of sisters separated by tragedy, and a cast of rising Indigenous talent. Starring Amber Midthunder, Alyssa Wapanatâhk, Isabel DeRoy-Olson, and Cara Jade Myers.

films.title: I Am Mario
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature
films.synopsis: A transgender taxi driver’s dream of fatherhood becomes a reality when he gets pregnant, forcing him to confront his own notions of masculinity while navigating unexpected social, moral, and emotional consequences.

films.title: I Play Rocky
films.genre: Biography + History / Films About Film / Romance / Sports
films.synopsis: Featuring a career-making performance from Anthony Ippolito, the latest from Oscar winner Peter Farrelly (TIFF ’18 People’s Choice Award winner Green Book) vividly recreates the story of how an unknown named Sylvester Stallone got Rocky produced — and became a superstar.

films.title: Idda
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: When two childhood friends meet after years to fulfill the broken promise of climbing Mount Etna, Adele and Sofia realize that like the mountain, old wounds loom over everything.

films.title: In Alaska
films.genre: First Nations Métis + Inuit / Action + Adventure / Mystery + Thriller / Crime / Canadian
films.synopsis: When a suicidal Inuk teen accidentally pierces an oil pipeline with a bullet, the FBI launches a full-scale manhunt across the northern wilderness in this drama starring Noomi Rapace (The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo) and newcomer Leo Matthew Temela.

films.title: In the Heart of the South
films.genre: Directed by Women / First Nations Métis + Inuit / Drama / Mystery + Thriller / Canadian
films.synopsis: In the Heart of the South is what Single White Female would be if it were set in Toronto, with an Inuk protagonist and a dash of supernatural elements, starring North of North’s Anna Lambe.

films.title: In Waves
films.genre: Animation / Drama / Romance
films.synopsis: Set under the confectionery pink and blue skies of California, this animated film narrates the love story between a young skater and a surfer who share a mutual passion for the ocean.

films.title: Inherit
films.genre: Horror / Drama / Mystery + Thriller / Adaptation / Asian Cultures
films.synopsis: Davika Hoorne plays her most magnetic role yet as Woranart – a grandma possessed by a demon – in the latest chilling psychological thriller by Shutter director Banjong Pisanthanakun.

films.title: Ink
films.country: United Kingdom, France, United States of America
films.genre: Biography + History / Drama / Adaptation
films.synopsis: Director Danny Boyle’s latest thrillingly charts the meteoric rise of Rupert Murdoch’s fledgling but instantly notorious The Sun newspaper as he and editor Larry Lamb create the blueprint for UK tabloid culture. Guy Pearce (The Brutalist, TIFF ’24) and Jack O’Connell star.

films.title: Innovation Hub
films.synopsis: An exhibition of award-winning and audience favourite projects that demonstrate the year’s best immersive storytelling, including interactive virtual reality experiences, mixed reality installations and AI glasses. The Innovation Hub is located on Level 200 of the Metro Toronto Convention Centre. Read more about the Innovation Hub's eight projects here. Press & Market Pass Holders: First-come, first-served access. Open Thursday, Sept. 10 – Monday, Sept. 14, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Public Access: Public Tickets available to be purchased for Tuesday, Sept. 15 - Wednesday, Sept. 16.

films.title: Intermission
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Biography + History / Films About Film / 2SLGBTQ+
films.synopsis: Yonfan transforms excerpts from his 15 films into a brilliant, genre-defying meditation on cinema, memory, beauty, desire, and his own singular body of work, featuring Maggie Cheung, Chow Yun-fat, Sylvia Chang, Shu Qi, Daniel Wu, and many, many more.

films.title: Iron Boy
films.genre: Animation / Coming of Age / Drama / Family Friendly
films.synopsis: Winner of the Special Jury Prize at Cannes last spring, Pixar animator Louis Clichy’s gorgeous hand-painted animation tells the story of a boy in need of a back brace who seeks the courage to stand alone.

films.title: It Will Happen Tonight
films.genre: Drama / Romance / Comedy
films.synopsis: Louis Garrel (TIFF ’25’s Couture) leads a charming ensemble in this decades-spanning divine dramady from Nanni Moretti (TIFF ’01’s The Son’s Room) that will restore your faith in destiny and the wild logic of the heart.

films.title: It's My Time
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Comedy / Drama / Sports
films.synopsis: Led by Oscar winner Michelle Yeoh (Everything Everywhere All at Once), this inspired comedy about a woman on the road to magic-cube mastery is a story of galvanizing gamesmanship and ageless defiance.

films.title: Josephine
films.genre: Crime / Drama / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: After witnessing an event, a young girl is haunted by the trauma of the disturbing incident, opening her eyes to the violence that surrounds her.

films.title: Julián
films.genre: Animation / Adaptation / Family Friendly / First Feature / Latin American Cultures / Canadian
films.synopsis: From the acclaimed studio behind Wolfwalkers and Song of the Sea comes a joyful adaptation of Jessica Love’s beloved children’s book about a young boy whose dream of becoming a mermaid transforms both his summer and his relationship with his grandmother.

films.title: Ken Russell's The Devils
films.genre: Drama / Horror
films.synopsis: North American Premiere of 4K restoration!

films.title: Kick On
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Horror / Crime
films.synopsis: Looking to prolong their night of partying, four youths are plunged into paranoid pandemonium after crossing a mobster’s volatile son in Nick Kozakis’ bloody ripper of a siege thriller.

films.title: Kissed
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / Romance / Canadian
films.synopsis: World Premiere of 4K restoration! Initially a controversial outlier, Lynne Stopkewich’s singular debut Kissed (TIFF ’96) is a subversive, tender drama about sexual awakening that shares the same ethereal atmosphere as erotic Canadian classics David Cronenberg’s Crash (1996) and Atom Egoyan’s Exotica (1994).

films.title: Krux
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature / War
films.synopsis: The feature debut of writer-director Tony Vahl delivers a powerful and stark portrait of moral collapse, societal panic, and the consequences of being on the wrong side of history.

films.title: L'AUTRE
films.section: Centrepiece, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Comedy / Mystery + Thriller / Horror / Canadian
films.synopsis: Wild delusions and genuine dangers threaten a patient recovering from cancer surgery in this visceral and darkly comedic thriller by Quebec’s Alexandre Franchi.

films.title: La Bola Negra
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Biography + History / Romance / War / Drama
films.synopsis: Los Javis’ ambitious and captivating homage to Federico García Lorca sees the lives of three men intertwined in love and loss across eras. Featuring powerful performances by Guitarricadelafuente, Carlos González, and Miguel Bernardeau.

films.title: La Gradiva
films.genre: Coming of Age / Directed by Women / Drama / First Feature
films.synopsis: A pack of rowdy French teenagers embark on a school field trip to Pompeii, where desire, passion, angst, and class tensions in the present unfold against the ruins of the ancient past.

films.title: Ladies and Gentlemen, Brian Mulroney
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Comedy / Documentary / Biography + History / Canadian
films.synopsis: This kaleidoscopic culture jam from visionary filmmaker Matthew Rankin (The Twentieth Century, Universal Language) details the rise of Canada’s 18th prime minister through a satirical collage of archival footage, television nostalgia, and national mythmaking.

films.title: Le Faux Soir
films.genre: Drama / Mystery + Thriller / War / Biography + History
films.synopsis: Inspired by a fact-based act of subversive irreverence in Nazi-occupied Brussels, Michaël R. Roskam’s thriller delivers a historical drama that feels more like a heist movie.

films.title: Lemonade
films.genre: Coming of Age / Directed by Women / Drama
films.synopsis: Lewis Brophy delivers a breakout performance in Kim Bartley’s compassionate debut drama about Irish teen, forced to leave foster care on his 18th birthday, who must find his way in a world that suddenly expects him to be a man.

films.title: Life of Jorge Luis Borges
films.genre: Documentary / Latin American Cultures / Experimental + Avant-Garde / Biography + History
films.synopsis: With the erudition and insight of a literary scholar and the gumption of an amateur detective, Argentinian auteur (and raconteur) Mariano Llinás (La Flor, TIFF ’18) explores the life and fiction of the legendary writer Jorge Luis Borges through objects and places.

films.title: Light Pillar
films.genre: Animation / Experimental + Avant-Garde / Science Fiction + Fantasy
films.synopsis: A lonely caretaker, a dying film studio, and a seductive virtual world collide in Xu Zao’s formally daring animated debut feature: a melancholic, visionary parable about cinema, technology, alienation, and the fragile promise of renewal.

films.title: Like Magic
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / First Feature / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: Blending archival footage, personal testimony, and a decades-long search for answers, Melissa Saavedra Gil transforms a childhood tragedy into a powerful exploration of memory, truth, and healing. An intimate and deeply resonant debut that illuminates both a personal story and a generation shaped by violence.

films.title: London
films.section: Wavelengths, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Drama / Experimental + Avant-Garde / First Feature
films.synopsis: An experimental yet tender road movie about an enigmatic man’s shared commutes across Austria’s scenic West Autobahn — shot in-studio with vintage rear-projection techniques — Sebastian Brameshuber’s award-winning London is a rare work of technical prowess that never belies its emotional core.

films.title: Long Long Night
films.genre: Animation / Adaptation
films.synopsis: This deeply moving debut from Kyu Bock Youm is a radiantly detailed animation chronicling the peripatetic lives of a rhino and a penguin as they traverse a vast, ever-changing wilderness brimming with natural beauty and human-generated danger.

films.title: Look Back
films.genre: Adaptation / Asian Cultures / Coming of Age / Drama / Animation
films.synopsis: Visionary auteur Hirokazu Kore-eda helms this tender and slow-burning adaptation of manga creator Tatsuki Fujimoto’s acclaimed story, following two young artists whose friendship and bond become the engine of their art.

films.title: Love is the monster
films.country: Costa Rica, Peru, Panama, Chile, Mexico
films.genre: Mystery + Thriller / Drama / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: In a chilling dystopian thriller shaped by fear and inequality, Neto Villalobos Brenes follows a grandmother, powerfully portrayed by Paulina García, whose granddaughter becomes the centre of a devastating turn of events that forces her into impossible moral choices.

films.title: Love of Your Life
films.genre: Coming of Age / Drama / Romance / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Featuring a beautifully understated performance from Margaret Qualley (TIFF ’24’s The Substance), this sweeping romantic character study from director Rachel Morrison (TIFF ’24’s The Fire Inside) is an exhilarating testament to loving fully, making amends, and moving on.

films.title: Low Lies The Land
films.genre: Documentary / Environment + Sustainability
films.synopsis: Set in the breathtaking landscapes of Piemonte in Northern Italy, Low Lies the Land immerses us in the lives of three winemaking families facing an uncertain future.

films.title: Madagascar
films.genre: Animation / Comedy / Family Friendly
films.synopsis: Madagascar is a 2005 American animated comedy film directed by Eric Darnell and Tom McGrath and written by Mark Burton, Billy Frolick, Darnell and McGrath. Produced by DreamWorks Animation and PDI/DreamWorks, the film stars the voices of Ben Stiller, Chris Rock, David Schwimmer and Jada Pinkett Smith as a quartet of anthropomorphic animals from the Central Park Zoo who find themselves stranded on the island of Madagascar and must adjust to living in the wild. Sacha Baron Cohen, Cedric the Entertainer, and Andy Richter also voice supporting roles.

films.title: Magazine
films.genre: Drama / Comedy / Romance / Coming of Age / Directed by Women / First Feature
films.synopsis: Set in New York’s cliquish literary scene, writer-director Alexandra Pechman’s feature debut chronicles the sentimental education of an aspiring poet (Lily McInerny, TIFF ’24’s Bonjour Tristesse) who becomes tangled in a web of eros, cultural gatekeeping, and office intrigue.

films.title: Making Waves With... Hudson Williams
films.section: In Conversation With..., TIFF Next Wave Selects

films.title: Man in Motion: The Rick Hansen Story
films.genre: Documentary / Biography + History / Sports / Canadian
films.synopsis: This galvanizing portrait celebrates Rick Hansen, the great Canadian athlete and activist. It chronicles his 26-month Man In Motion World Tour: a 40,000-kilometre wheelchair journey that raised millions to eliminate accessibility barriers and transform public perception of people with disabilities.

films.title: Marie Madeleine
films.genre: Directed by Women / Drama / Black + African Diaspora
films.synopsis: Géssica Généus directs and stars in this vibrant reimagining of the biblical tale of Mary Magdalene, following a free-spirited Haitian sex worker whose serendipitous involvement with a repressed preacher’s son opens each to possibilities.

films.title: Masc
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Drama / First Feature
films.synopsis: This debut feature from London-based artist Bertil Nilsson is a tender, unflinching portrait of self-performance, identity, and the quiet but persistent work of learning to exist as oneself in an often prescriptive world.

films.title: Memories of a Forest
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature / Coming of Age / Environment + Sustainability
films.synopsis: Katharina Rabl’s stunning debut feature toggles between loyalty and longing for independence, centring a doctoral student who must choose between carrying on her family’s legacy or forging her own path.

films.title: Minotaur
films.genre: Drama / Crime / Adaptation / War
films.synopsis: After a nine-year hiatus, during which he fled his native Russia into exile, Andrey Zvyagintsev (The Return, TIFF ’03, Leviathan, TIFF ’14) returns with a reworking of Claude Chabrol's La femme infidèle, adapted to his homeland's current rhetoric of patriarchy and warmongering.

films.title: Misty Green
films.genre: Drama / Films About Film / Romance / Comedy / Black + African Diaspora
films.synopsis: Featuring a career-making performance from Slow Horses’ Rosalind Eleazar and supporting turns from Daniel Kaluuya, Adam Driver, and Anna Kendrick, Chris Rock’s latest as writer-director brilliantly satirizes the bigotry and hustle at the heart of Hollywood.

films.title: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?
films.genre: War / Drama / Adaptation
films.synopsis: Cult Japanese filmmaker Shinya Tsukamoto directs acclaimed Broadway actor Rodney Hicks and Oscar winner Geoffrey Rush in a harrowing, visceral, and morally urgent portrait of Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson.

films.title: Musk
films.genre: Documentary / Biography + History
films.synopsis: The Oscar-winning documentarian Alex Gibney delivers his most ambitious and epic work in exploring the history of the world’s richest man, Elon Musk.

films.title: Muyi
films.genre: Animation / Science Fiction + Fantasy / Asian Cultures / First Feature
films.synopsis: A teenager undertakes a fantastic journey in order to save her mountaintop village where men are forbidden, in Julien Chheng’s charming and magical animated feature.

films.title: My Wife Cries
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / Experimental + Avant-Garde / Romance
films.synopsis: With My Wife Cries — a startling, minimalist study in romantic misalignment — German auteur and Festival favourite Angela Schanelec employs her singular style to portray the crushing anguish and vertiginous confusion brought forth by marital crisis.

films.title: Neil Peart: No One's Disciple
films.genre: Documentary / Music / Canadian
films.synopsis: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson team up with four revered drummers — Stewart Copeland, Danny Carey, Chad Smith, and Gavin Harrison — for an exhilarating and poignant tribute to late Rush legend Neil Peart.

films.title: Neverman
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Drama / Canadian
films.synopsis: Broadway and cabaret icon Justin Vivian Bond stars as a transgender gay rights activist with worsening Alzheimer disease suffering from the treatment in her nursing home, in Rodrigo Barriuso’s poignant second feature.

films.title: Nobody's Violence
films.genre: Drama / Experimental + Avant-Garde / Mystery + Thriller / Canadian
films.synopsis: Larissa Corriveau delivers a striking performance as an enigmatic death-dealer in this bold, bracing, and Buñuelian feature by Denis Côté.

films.title: Nosotros
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Aboriginal + Indigenous / First Feature
films.synopsis: After leaving his Indigenous family for work in Guatemala City, a lonely security guard falls for a business owner at the mall he patrols, discovering an unexpected refuge and a new sense of self in a world not yet ready to make space for them.

films.title: Now You See Me
films.genre: Mystery + Thriller / Crime
films.synopsis: Now You See Me is a 2013 American heist film directed by Louis Leterrier from a screenplay by Ed Solomon, Boaz Yakin, and Edward Ricourt and a story by Yakin and Ricourt. It is the first instalment in the Now You See Me series. The film features an ensemble cast of Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo, Woody Harrelson, Mélanie Laurent, Isla Fisher, Common, Dave Franco, Michael Caine and Morgan Freeman. The plot follows an FBI agent and an Interpol detective who track and attempt to bring to justice a team of magicians who pull off bank heists and robberies during their performances and reward their audiences with the money.

films.title: Obsession
films.genre: Horror / First Feature / Cult
films.synopsis: When a hopeless romantic makes a wish that his long-time crush falls in love with him, a sinister enchantment ensues in writer-director Curry Barker’s freaky and frightening feature debut.

films.title: On Behalf of My Son
films.genre: Drama / Black + African Diaspora / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: Anchored by a deeply affecting performance from Rejane Faria, Gabriel Martins’ moving drama follows a grieving mother seeking forgiveness from the families of a tragic bus accident. What unfolds is a profound meditation on guilt and whether forgiveness is possible.

films.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.genre: Documentary / Black + African Diaspora / Films About Film
films.synopsis: Conceived in 1972 by legendary filmmaker William Greaves and completed 50 years later by his son David, Once Upon a Time in Harlem is an essential work of living archive, documenting a lively gathering of luminaries from the Harlem Renaissance during a cocktail party at Duke Ellington’s home.

films.title: Onwards and Sideways
films.section: Gala Presentations, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Drama / Romance
films.synopsis: The latest from Oscar-nominated director John Madden (Shakespeare in Love) stars Oscar nominee Laura Linney (TIFF ’08’s The Savages) and Rhys Ifans (TIFF ’23’s Mother Couch) as strangers whose lives become entwined when both are diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease.

films.title: Our Loves
films.genre: Drama / War / Jewish Cultures / First Feature
films.synopsis: The latest from Avi Nesher (TIFF '16's Past Life) is a gracefully woven drama about the ways that love intensifies and second chances are possible in the face of adversity and mayhem.

films.title: Oxygen Masks Will (Not) Drop Automatically
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Biography + History / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: The first-ever series from renowned Brazilian filmmaker Marcelo Gomes tells the true story of a group of young flight attendants who smuggle treatment drugs from America into the hands of patients with AIDS in 1980s Brazil.

films.title: Paradise Lost
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Crime / Mystery + Thriller / Science Fiction + Fantasy
films.synopsis: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother’s son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created in this sharp thriller from Yeon Sang-ho.

films.title: Pelechian Project
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Documentary / Biography + History / Asian Cultures / Films About Film
films.synopsis: North American premiere of 4K restorations! One of the year’s greatest cinematic gifts, this programme brings together five newly restored films by the pioneering Armenian filmmaker Artavazd Pelechian, each a harrowing ode to humanity, and its natural cycles of existence.

films.title: Phoolan
films.genre: Biography + History / Drama
films.synopsis: In the heartland of India, a young Phoolan Devi becomes one of the most famous outlaws in Indian history and the target of 2,000 heavily armed men sent to kill her over a gruelling 48-hour siege.

films.title: Possible Love
films.genre: Drama / Asian Cultures / Romance
films.synopsis: Lee Chang-dong’s eagerly anticipated new film brings stories of relationships, generational and class divides, in this gripping tale of two couples playing games with themselves and one another.

films.title: Pretenders
films.genre: Documentary / Music / Biography + History
films.synopsis: Tough, stylish, and effortlessly cool, the Pretenders founder Chrissie Hynde is the real thing. Grounded in extensive interviews with Hynde and archival materials, Pretenders chronicles the evolution of one of rock’s most singular icons.

films.title: Prima Facie
films.genre: Adaptation / Drama / Directed by Women / Black + African Diaspora
films.synopsis: Oscar nominee Cynthia Erivo (Wicked) stars in this adaptation of Suzie Miller’s globally acclaimed play that examines what happens when an ambitious barrister who primarily defends those accused of sex crimes unexpectedly becomes the accuser in a sexual assault case.

films.title: Purgatory
films.genre: First Feature / Coming of Age / Comedy / Canadian
films.synopsis: This coming-of-age dramedy, set in the 1980s, follows Beatrice as she tries to reunite her recently separated parents, and stars J.K. Simmons, Abby Elliott, John Reynolds, and Jack Innanen.

films.title: Rapinoe
films.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Sports / Biography + History
films.synopsis: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe explores what it means to win and lose in this intimate portrait by Rebeca Huntt (Beba).

films.title: Re/Pair
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Jewish Cultures / Black + African Diaspora
films.synopsis: Lacey Schwartz Delgado (Little White Lie) explores the bonds and tensions between American Black and Jewish communities in a series of dialogues with prominent figures.

films.title: REDEFINED | Short Film Showcase
films.section: TIFF Next Wave Selects, Special Events
films.synopsis: Catch the premiere of REDEFINED at the Toronto International Film Festival and streaming worldwide on the NFB. Following the screening, join us for a Q&A with the filmmakers. This programme will be presented with closed captioning for English-language titles and subtitles for non-English-language titles.

films.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Middle Eastern Cultures
films.synopsis: Acclaimed actor-turned-documentarian Pegah Ahangarani draws on a trove of archival material to skillfully weave her personal narrative with Iranian politics over the past four decades.

films.title: Report to Mother
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Biography + History / Drama / Experimental + Avant-Garde
films.synopsis: North American Premiere of 4K restoration! A daring clarion call and one of the most significant works of Indian political cinema, John Abraham’s extraordinary final film Amma Ariyan (Report to Mother) follows a young man in 1970s Kerala as he journeys — with a progressive swell of companions — to inform a mother of her son’s death, amid widespread unrest.

films.title: Rescue
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Director Sine Plambech (Heartbound, TIFF ’18) documents the kidnapping of a mother and her long quest to be reunited with her husband, illuminating a mass crisis experienced by migrants in the Mediterranean.

films.title: River
films.genre: Horror / Drama / Cult / First Feature
films.synopsis: Joshua Giuliano makes an audacious debut with a suspenseful slasher that sets three embittered siblings adrift along a rural waterway, and in the sights of a masked killer.

films.title: Rogue Trooper
films.genre: Animation / Science Fiction + Fantasy / Action + Adventure / Adaptation / War
films.synopsis: Directed by Duncan Jones (Moon, Warcraft), this outlandish animated adaptation of the influential British comic book follows a clone soldier bred for an interstellar forever-war and his fallen comrades whose personalities live on within his gun, helmet, and backpack.

films.title: Run Terry Run
films.genre: Documentary / Sports / Biography + History / Canadian
films.synopsis: This intimate and inspiring portrait from filmmaker Sean Menard (TIFF ’17’s The Carter Effect) draws upon never-before-seen footage to reveal the arduous process and profound commitment behind Terry Fox’s Marathon of Hope to raise awareness and money for cancer research.

films.title: Salvation
films.section: Discovery, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Drama / First Feature / Comedy
films.synopsis: A hunger for purpose and a flair for delusion in a small Scottish town: Tom Nicoll’s debut is a sharp, empathetic portrait of young men adrift.

films.title: Seventeen
films.genre: First Feature / First Nations Métis + Inuit / 2SLGBTQ+ / Coming of Age / Drama / Canadian
films.synopsis: Three young queer Indigenous people’s lives intersect and overlap over the course of 17 hours in downtown Vancouver.
