films.title: Silenced Nights
films.genre: Drama / Crime
films.synopsis: For some, staying silent is the only way to survive. Lawrence Fajardo’s bleak sociopolitical drama Silenced Nights follows a witness to an extrajudicial killing in a Philippines slum as he seeks to make the truth known.

films.title: Sisters
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: Outside of Madrid, two sisters unite their families on a summer weekend, celebrating milestones and the solstice-heralding San Juan Festival. However, joy quickly turns to horror when a serious allegation of sexual abuse surfaces from one of their children.

films.title: Slow Horses
films.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
films.genre: Crime / Comedy / Adaptation
films.synopsis: The sixth season of this smash hit series finds the motley crew of disgraced MI5 agents in Slough House, working under the cantankerous Jackson Lamb (Gary Oldman, TIFF ’17’s Darkest Hour), thrown once again into the fray.

films.title: Smudge the Blades
films.genre: Comedy / Coming of Age / First Nations Métis + Inuit / Sports / Canadian
films.synopsis: A fresh take on the underdog sports film, centring on an Indigenous hockey team in Northern Alberta, from actor and director Cody Lightning (Hey, Viktor!, TIFF ’23) and starring Ed Helms, Jana Schmieding, and Paulina Alexis.

films.title: Soumsoum, The Night of the Stars
films.genre: Drama / Black + African Diaspora / Romance
films.synopsis: Five years after Lingui, the Sacred Bonds, Chadian director Mahamat-Saleh Haroun returns to TIFF with his latest feature, winner of the FIPRESCI Award at the 2026 Berlinale.

films.title: Spirit Guardians: The Last Secret of the First Emperor
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Asian Cultures / Drama / Biography + History
films.synopsis: The largest production in Vietnamese history, this sweeping epic from Nguyễn Phan Quang Binh (The Floating Lives) transports us to the Đinh dynasty, when a band of fearless warriors set out on a secret mission to safeguard a sacred mystery.

films.title: Spring in a Small Town
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Drama / Romance
films.synopsis: World Premiere of 4K restoration! Crowned the greatest Chinese film ever made by the Hong Kong Film Critics Society, director Fei Mu’s poetic, romantic 1948 masterpiece observes a bored wife enlivened by a surprise visit from an old flame, whose presence threatens to upend the matrimonial home.

films.title: Spy Kids
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Comedy / Family Friendly
films.synopsis: Spy Kids is a 2001 American spy action comedy film written and directed by Robert Rodriguez. The film stars Alexa Vega, Daryl Sabara, Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alan Cumming, Teri Hatcher, Cheech Marin, Danny Trejo, Robert Patrick and Tony Shalhoub. Spy Kids premiered at Disney California Adventure in Anaheim, California on March 18, 2001, and was released in the United States on March 30, by Dimension Films. An extended cut, titled Spy Kids: Special Edition, was released in US theaters on August 8, 2001. The film received positive reviews from critics and grossed $147.9 million against a production budget of $35 million.

films.title: Still Night, Burning House
films.genre: Directed by Women / Documentary / Asian Cultures / Biography + History / First Feature / Canadian
films.synopsis: A once-close family comes together to say goodbye to an uncle who struggled with mental health issues, in award-winning short filmmaker Carol Nguyen’s tender and emotional feature-length documentary debut.

films.title: Strangers on a Train
films.genre: Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: Strangers on a Train is a 1951 American psychological thriller film noir produced and directed by Alfred Hitchcock, and adapted by Raymond Chandler and Czenzi Ormonde from the 1950 novel of the same name by Patricia Highsmith. It was shot in late 1950, and released by Warner Bros. Pictures on June 30, 1951, starring Farley Granger, Ruth Roman and Robert Walker. The story concerns two strangers who meet on a train, one of whom is a psychopath who suggests that they "exchange" murders so that neither will be caught. The film initially received mixed reviews, but has since been regarded much more favorably.

films.title: Strong Son
films.genre: Drama / Sports / First Feature / Asian Cultures / Canadian
films.synopsis: A bodybuilder struggles to keep it together as he cares for his elderly father in this perceptive and deeply felt drama by Winnipeg’s Ian Bawa.

films.title: Stuffed
films.genre: Musical / Drama / Comedy / Cult / Romance / First Feature
films.synopsis: Love, death, and taxidermy collide in this gloriously twisted musical, one of the year’s funniest, most original, and unexpectedly heartfelt romances.

films.title: Sunburn
films.genre: Black + African Diaspora / Coming of Age / Comedy / Asian Cultures / Canadian
films.synopsis: Over one hot summer day in Toronto, a group of young people try to survive the heatwave and a blackout by making jokes, roaming the city, and forming tangible connections that feel like they can disappear at any moment.

films.title: Tangles
films.genre: Animation / Adaptation / 2SLGBTQ+ / First Feature / Directed by Women / Canadian
films.synopsis: A young woman deals with her vibrant mother’s Alzheimer diagnosis in this deeply moving animation adapted from a graphic memoir, with a voice cast including Abbi Jacobson, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Seth Rogen, and Bowen Yang.

films.title: Tehran, Under the Skin
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Middle Eastern Cultures
films.synopsis: In an age of body anxiety, filmmaker Afsaneh Salari embeds herself in the offices of Iranian plastic surgeons to interview their clients with humour and empathy.

films.title: Ten Dark Women
films.genre: Asian Cultures / Comedy
films.synopsis: North American Premiere of 4K restoration! In the stylish, satirical, and ahead-of-its-time Ten Dark Women (Kuroi jûnin no onna, 1961), by legendary Japanese director Kon Ichikawa, 10 women discover they are sharing the same pathologically unfaithful man, and temporarily abandon jealousy to meticulously orchestrate a collective revenge.

films.title: Tender Loving Care
films.genre: Drama
films.synopsis: Seven-time Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with an uplifting story of family and how to deal with grief, featuring remarkably emotional performances from Kate O’Flynn and Alice Bailey Johnson.

films.title: Tenzing
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Biography + History / Drama / Sports
films.synopsis: Starring Tom Hiddleston (TIFF ’24’s The Life of Chuck), Oscar nominee Willem Dafoe, and Genden Phuntsok (TIFF ’18’s Jinpa), this wondrous biopic recounts the story of Himalayan Sherpa mountaineer Tenzing Norgay who, alongside Edmund Hillary, became first to top Everest in 1953.

films.title: The Age of Goodbyes
films.genre: Adaptation / Drama / Mystery + Thriller / Romance / Asian Cultures
films.synopsis: Vivian Sung stars as the ravishing Du Li An in a breathtaking cinematic adaptation of Li Zi Shu’s The Age of Goodbyes, a story about memory, loss, love, doppelgängers, and hidden truths.

films.title: The Assassin(s)
films.genre: Biography + History / Mystery + Thriller / Drama / Asian Cultures
films.synopsis: Based on the attempted assassination of South Korean President Park Chung-hee, the latest from Hur Jin-ho (TIFF ’23’s A Normal Family) is a large-canvas procedural about police and journalists determined to uncover a seemingly impenetrable conspiracy.

films.title: The Beloved
films.genre: Drama / Films About Film
films.synopsis: Starring Oscar winner Javier Bardem and Victoria Luengo (TIFF ’24’s The Room Next Door), the latest from Rodrigo Sorogoyen (TIFF ’18’s The Realm) chronicles an unnerving collaboration between a charismatic, manipulative director and the actor daughter he hasn’t seen in 13 years.

films.title: The Betrayers
films.genre: Drama / Adaptation / Jewish Cultures / War / Canadian
films.synopsis: In adapting his own literary prize-winner, Toronto’s David Bezmozgis delivers a deft political thriller about the limits of love and loyalty.

films.title: The Black Box is Orange
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Directed by Women / First Feature / Canadian
films.synopsis: The debut feature by Toronto artist and filmmaker Yuula Benivolski, The Black Box is Orange is a multimodal, autobiographical essay film that deploys both personal memory and incomplete archives to reflect on a childhood in a militarized border town.

films.title: The bovine with the curved horns
films.genre: Latin American Cultures / Drama / First Feature
films.synopsis: Blending Caribbean fantasy, magical realism, and Colombia’s painful history, The bovine with the curved horns follows a boy searching for his missing father through a landscape where myth and violence coexist. A haunting, poetic debut of remarkable beauty and emotional power.

films.title: The City of the Living
films.genre: Drama / Adaptation / Crime
films.synopsis: The City of the Living is Edoardo Gabbriellini’s (Holiday, TIFF ’23) gripping yet respectful anti-true crime film based on Nicola Lagioia’s bestselling literary chronicle about the senseless 2016 murder of a young man that rocked Rome.

films.title: The Daughters of Abraham
films.genre: Directed by Women / Drama / Middle Eastern Cultures / Jewish Cultures
films.synopsis: A young Muslim woman raised in Marseille reunites with a young Jewish woman after a period of estrangement, reconnecting as friends over summer break. When a sudden tragedy disrupts their carefree holiday, the pair face the similarities and differences that strengthen and threaten their relationship together.

films.title: The Debut
films.genre: Drama / Comedy / Musical
films.synopsis: Jesse Eisenberg directs Academy Award winner Julianne Moore and Paul Giamatti in a dark comedy about a bored suburban housewife who finds purpose acting in community theatre.

films.title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
films.genre: Drama / Adaptation
films.synopsis: Offering his most provocative work yet, the latest from Romanian provocateur Radu Jude is a surprisingly tender socioeconomic satire.

films.title: The Difficult Bride
films.genre: Directed by Women / Drama / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: Following the strange visions afflicting a woman on the cusp of marriage, the latest from Rubaiyat Hossain (TIFF ’19’s Made in Bangladesh) examines the pressures applied to brides in a milieu where weddings demand an asphyxiating feminine ideal.

films.title: The Dreamed Adventure
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / Crime
films.synopsis: Winner of the Jury Prize in the competition section of the Cannes Film Festival, The Dreamed Adventure is German auteur Valeska Grisebach's highly anticipated and exceptional follow up to Western (TIFF ’17).

films.title: The F Word
films.genre: Romance / Comedy

films.title: The Face of Horror
films.genre: Horror / Adaptation / Romance / Cult / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: The Love Witch’s Anna Biller stunningly adapts the famous Japanese ghost story Yotsuya Kaidan for 14th-century England in this gory tribute to classic Technicolor shockers.

films.title: The Final Act
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Canadian
films.synopsis: Quebec’s Sophie Deraspe returns to the Festival with a philosophical and intimate look at the many profound issues surrounding both death and medically assisted dying in an extraordinary documentary.

films.title: The Fortunate Isles
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / Black + African Diaspora
films.synopsis: In the 16th century, on the newly conquered Canary Islands, colonial misgivings intersect with personal desperation. Fátima, an enslaved and pregnant woman, must struggle to survive both the landscape, and the other inhabitants.

films.title: The Great Muppet Caper
films.genre: Crime / Comedy / Family Friendly
films.synopsis: The Great Muppet Caper is a 1981 musical heist comedy film directed by Jim Henson (in his feature directorial debut). It is the second theatrical film featuring the Muppets. The film stars Muppet performers Henson, Frank Oz, Dave Goelz, Jerry Nelson, Richard Hunt, and Steve Whitmire, as well as Charles Grodin and Diana Rigg, with special cameo appearances by John Cleese, Robert Morley, Peter Ustinov, and Jack Warden. The film was produced by ITC Entertainment and The Jim Henson Company and distributed by Universal Pictures. In the plot, the Muppets are caught up in a jewel heist while investigating a robbery in London.

films.title: The Housewife
films.genre: Drama / Biography + History / War
films.synopsis: Grounded in artful performances from Oscar nominee Naomi Watts (TIFF ’01’s Mulholland Drive) and Tye Sheridan (TIFF ’13’s Joe), this salient historical drama depicts the complexities of seeking justice in the long shadow of Nazism.

films.title: The Hummingbird Paints Fragrant Songs
films.country: Peru, United States of America, Qatar
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Aboriginal + Indigenous / Latin American Cultures
films.synopsis: The Indigenous painter Sara Flores gets discovered by the international art world in her 70s, setting her off on an adventure as she travels from her home in the Peruvian Amazon to be fȇted in galleries from New York to Paris.

films.title: The Idiot(s)
films.genre: Drama / Adaptation
films.synopsis: Aimee Lou Wood and Johnny Flynn bring to life the story of Anna and Fyodor Dostoevsky, showcasing the troubled author and the woman who pushed him to write one of his greatest works.

films.title: The Julia Set
films.genre: Drama / Coming of Age / Romance / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Chase Infiniti stars as a gifted university student who becomes romantically involved with a teaching assistant as they both prepare for the Putnam Exam, the most challenging math competition in North America. Gillian Anderson and Jason Isaacs co-star.

films.title: The Last Photograph
films.synopsis: Starring Stuart Martin, Fra Fee, and Costanza Andrade, the latest from Zack Snyder (300) follows an ex-DEA agent seeking revenge in a South American jungle where dangerous terrain and inner demons intermingle.

films.title: The Liberation
films.genre: Biography + History / Cult / Crime / Drama
films.synopsis: Carrie Coon soars in the riveting story inspired by filmmaker Guy Nattiv’s grandmother, whose humdrum day-to-day life is upended by a mysterious and entrancing young woman (Lily James) offering the promise of escape to something better.

films.title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
films.genre: Crime / Drama / Romance / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: Starring Oscar nominee Amanda Seyfried (The Testament of Ann Lee, TIFF ’25) and Scoot McNairy (Nightbitch, TIFF ’24), the latest from Tim Blake Nelson is a psychologically rich prison story about crime, punishment, and love.

films.title: The Lost Children Of Tuam
films.genre: Biography + History / Drama
films.synopsis: A quietly powerful true story of an amateur historian’s quest to uncover a long-buried injustice. By exposing what rightly became a national scandal, Catherine Corless changed Ireland forever.

films.title: The Man I Love
films.genre: 2SLGBTQ+ / Drama
films.synopsis: Ira Sachs’ vision of New York artists living under the spectre of AIDS in the ’80s focuses on the joy and salvation of creativity.

films.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
films.genre: Crime / Drama / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: Anchored by John Turturro’s charismatic performance, this low-key crime drama from Noah Segan (Blood Relatives) harkens back to the character-driven films of 1970s New Hollywood.

films.title: The Pervert's Guide to Utopias
films.country: Ireland, United Kingdom, Slovenia, Netherlands, Norway
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women / Films About Film
films.synopsis: Twenty years after The Pervert’s Guide to Cinema, the renowned intellectual Slavoj Žižek reunites with director Sophie Fiennes for a fresh meditation on movies and ideas that crackles with energy.

films.title: The Remotes
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Asian Cultures / Mystery + Thriller / Science Fiction + Fantasy
films.synopsis: This ambitious, beguiling narrative debut from acclaimed Filipino filmmaker and experimentalist John Torres follows a grieving detective who finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

films.title: The Road Not Taken
films.genre: Drama / Asian Cultures
films.synopsis: Peter Ho-Sun Chan directs Zhou Xun, Wen Qi, Tian Zhuangzhuang and Wang Xiao in a drama about early-onset Alzheimer disease. Combining expert storytelling with commercial appeal, The Road Not Taken reflects on what remains when our understanding of the world begins to disappear.

films.title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
films.genre: Black + African Diaspora / Comedy / Adaptation / Drama
films.synopsis: A wealthy patriarch’s fragile household unravels when the youngest of his four wives fails to conceive. Blending sharp Nollywood wit with tenderness, this deeply satisfying drama explores topics of infertility, gendered inheritance, and shifting family power.

films.title: The Smell of Apples
films.genre: Drama / Environment + Sustainability / Biography + History / Adaptation
films.synopsis: In John Trengove’s relentless third feature, a sheltered 11-year-old white South African boy gradually comes to realize the horrors of the apartheid system.

films.title: The Spiral
films.genre: Horror / Drama
films.synopsis: Director Paolo Strippoli turns the screws on a desperate mother (Jasmine Trinca) as she confesses a series of Faustian bargains to her estranged daughter (Romana Maggiora Vergano) in this riveting morality chiller.

films.title: The Stunt Driver
films.genre: Comedy / Adaptation / Biography + History / Cult / Canadian
films.synopsis: Jay Baruchel and director Michael Dowse re-team for a raucous yet heartfelt comedy about a Canadian stuntman who dared to dream big and fly (very) high.

films.title: The Surgeon
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Mystery + Thriller / Drama
films.synopsis: Oscar winner Michelle Yeoh (Everything Everywhere All at Once) is back in action as a kidnapped surgeon forced to perform one last operation in this fun, pulse-pounding thriller.

films.title: The Ultra Runner
films.genre: Documentary / Sports / War / Biography + History / Canadian
films.synopsis: Punishing tests of human endurance become a means of escaping past demons for the unforgettable subject of Mila Aung-Thwin’s superb new film.

films.title: The Unknown
films.genre: Mystery + Thriller / Drama / Cult
films.synopsis: A highlight of this year’s Cannes Competition, the third feature by acclaimed French filmmaker, actor, and screenwriter Arthur Harari (co-writer of Anatomy of a Fall) is a moody, existential body-swap puzzler starring an extraordinary Léa Seydoux and a near-unrecognizable Niels Schneider.

films.title: The Violinist
films.section: Centrepiece, Unhidden Gems presented by Redbreast
films.genre: Animation / War / Music / Romance / Drama
films.synopsis: Winner of this year’s Annecy Cristal award, this intimate animation about two violinists in Singapore circa WWII highlights the healing power of music while pulling heartstrings.

films.title: The World Before
films.genre: Coming of Age / Drama / Romance / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Yoon Dan-bi’s coming-of-age story follows two childhood best friends who reunite for a summer on a remote Korean island. This beautifully constructed slice of life captures the emotional intensity of adolescence through assured filmmaking and compelling performances.

films.title: Thirteen in Gaza
films.genre: Coming of Age / War / Drama / Middle Eastern Cultures
films.synopsis: Palestinian director Hosam Abu Dan makes his narrative feature debut with a nuanced and deeply human portrait of a father and his teenage daughter navigating everyday life in a refugee camp in the Gaza Strip.

films.title: Toy Gun Bandit
films.genre: Crime / Comedy / Mystery + Thriller / Canadian
films.synopsis: A prank gone wrong launches a Quebec teen into a life of crime in Rémi St-Michel’s energetic and unpredictable second feature.

films.title: Trash Mountain
films.genre: Drama / 2SLGBTQ+ / Romance / Comedy / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: After the death of their hoarder father in rural Missouri, two siblings (Caleb Hearon and Zooey Deschanel) reunite to sort through the baggage — both literal and emotional — in Kris Rey’s poignant and funny exploration of love and grief.

films.title: Trees are Watching
films.genre: Mystery + Thriller / Drama / Horror / Middle Eastern Cultures / Environment + Sustainability
films.synopsis: Iranian Kurdish auteur Bahman Ghobadi blends psychological horror and ecological allegory as he depicts the eerie haunting of a writer (Eva Green) reckoning with past misdeeds under the ominous gaze of a pair of trees and a malignant wooden chair.

films.title: Turtle Island Rap
films.genre: Documentary / Music / First Feature / First Nations Métis + Inuit / Canadian
films.synopsis: The bumpy road to success experienced by three aspiring Indigenous hip-hop artists is the focus of Alexandra Lazarowich’s (Fast Horse) verité-style feature documentary debut.

films.title: Union Town
films.genre: Documentary / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Barbara Kopple (TIFF ’76’s Harlan County, U.S.A.) looks at three crucial labour battles as they unfold in New York City involving workers from UPS, Amazon, and deliveristas for DoorDash and GrubHub.

films.title: Up Against It
films.genre: Coming of Age / Drama / Romance / Directed by Women
films.synopsis: Post-marital acrimony and parental devotion make strange bedfellows in Trudie Styler’s wicked comedy, starring Oscar nominee Antonio Banderas (TIFF ’19’s Pain and Glory) and Eva Birthistle (TIFF ’05’s Imagine Me & You) as co-parenting divorcees faced with an indecent proposal.

films.title: Villeneuve: The Rise of a Legend
films.genre: Biography + History / Drama / Sports / Canadian
films.synopsis: Chronicling the exhilarating career of Gilles Villeneuve, one of Canada’s foremost athletes, this biopic from director Yan Lanouette Turgeon stars Rémi Goulet as the kid from Quebec who changed Formula One.

films.title: Vintage Violence
films.section: Midnight Madness, TIFF Next Wave Selects
films.genre: Action + Adventure / Romance / Crime / Cult / Asian Cultures
films.synopsis: In Eugene Kotlyarenko’s mixed-media caper, a livestreamer (Cole Sprouse) discovers a cache of vintage denim only to run afoul of the Yakuza when he is lured to Japan to sell the jeans by one of his subscribers (Kiko Mizuhara).

films.title: Viva Carmen
films.genre: Animation / Drama / Musical
films.synopsis: A vibrant reframing of Bizet’s famous opera through the lens of a pack of Sevillian street children who are determined to subvert Carmen’s tragic fate. With an intimate approach to music and bold brushstrokes that dance, this animated feature sings brightly.

films.title: Voices
films.genre: Musical / Crime / First Feature / Drama / Black + African Diaspora
films.synopsis: A starry-eyed bellhop (Francis Edemobi) enlists his friends to help him exploit an unsavoury opportunity that could secure them fame and fortune in Deantè Gray’s soulful, suspenseful 1960s-set musical chamber thriller.

films.title: Wavelengths 1: House and Home
films.genre: Canadian / Experimental + Avant-Garde / Directed by Women / Documentary
films.synopsis: Bringing together new work by John Smith, Rita Ferrando, Jiaqi Yu, Danaya Chulphuthiphong, Mustafa Uzuner, and Natalia Marín, the films in this programme reflect on the nature of abodes, both fixed and temporary, and the limit of refuge.

films.title: Wavelengths 2: This Suffocating Now
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / 2SLGBTQ+ / Biography + History / Films About Film
films.synopsis: Featuring new films by Maryam Tafakory, Zheng Lu Xinyuan, Simon Liu, and Vika Kirchenbauer, alongside a rediscovered and restored short by Takehisa Kosugi, the films in this programme speak to the political potential of creative work, creative scenes, and companionship.

films.title: Wavelengths 3: Time and Tide
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Films About Film / Environment + Sustainability
films.synopsis: Featuring new work by James Richards and Ben Russell, a rare 70mm projection by Johann Lurf, and a tribute to the recently departed Yervant Gianikian, the films of Time and Tide bend eras, epochs, and the cosmos with both verve and grace.

films.title: Wavelengths: Anoushahpour/Aljafari
films.genre: Experimental + Avant-Garde / Documentary / Directed by Women / Films About Film
films.synopsis: Bringing together new works by Parastoo Anoushahpour and Kamal Aljafari, the two films in this programme reflect on the meeting point between imagination and memory — both personal and collective — from the perspective of children and the aged.

films.title: We Are All Strangers
films.genre: Drama / Asian Cultures / Coming of Age
films.synopsis: Anthony Chen, a Festival favourite and the helmer behind Ilo Ilo, reunites with muses Yeo Yann Yann and Koh Jia Ler in an emotionally charged drama about a constructed family to close his “Growing Up” trilogy.

films.title: We Are Born Good
films.genre: Drama / Asian Cultures / 2SLGBTQ+
films.synopsis: Golden Horse winner Suet Ying Chung and Wai Lun Yeung lead Leung Chuen Yeung’s assured debut, in which a struggling actress and an ex-con restaurant owner turn a petty dispute into an unlikely bond. Witty, moving, and accessible.

films.title: What Lies Between Us
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / First Feature
films.synopsis: From Danish director Amalie Næsby Fick and a cast led by Sidse Babett Knudsen comes a compelling cautionary tale about the ethical and moral boundaries a parent may cross in order to protect a child.

films.title: Whatcha Want
films.genre: Directed by Women / Asian Cultures / Romance / Musical / Canadian
films.synopsis: The latest comedy from writer-director Mina Shum (Double Happiness, TIFF ’17’s Meditation Park) tells the story of a young woman from Hong Kong whose marriage to an affluent businessman is beginning to resemble a gilded cage.

films.title: Where the River Begins
films.genre: Drama / Latin American Cultures / Aboriginal + Indigenous / War / Canadian
films.synopsis: In Juan Andrés Arango’s bracing and poetic third feature, an Emberá woman displaced by violence undertakes a dangerous journey to find a better life for herself and her daughter.

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.genre: Comedy / Crime / Drama / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: Two CIA agents (John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell) are sent on a mission to Easter Island, where one faces an existential crisis over his past actions, in Martin McDonagh’s latest dark comedy.

films.title: Wild, Wild East
films.genre: Drama / War / Jewish Cultures / Western
films.synopsis: Set in occupied Poland in the middle of the Second World War, Jan Holoubek’s tour-de-force is part suspenseful western, part gritty wartime noir.

films.title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
films.genre: Family Friendly / Science Fiction + Fantasy / Musical
films.synopsis: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory is a 1971 American musical fantasy film directed by Mel Stuart from a screenplay by Roald Dahl, based on Dahl's 1964 novel Charlie and the Chocolate Factory. It stars Gene Wilder as chocolatier Willy Wonka. The film tells the story of a poor child named Charlie Bucket (Peter Ostrum) who, upon finding a Golden Ticket in a chocolate bar, wins the chance to visit Willy Wonka's chocolate factory along with four other children from around the world. Filming took place in Munich from August to November 1970. Dahl was credited with writing the film's screenplay; however, David Seltzer was brought in to do an uncredited rewrite.

films.title: Woman Unknown
films.genre: Drama / Directed by Women / War / Biography + History / Mystery + Thriller
films.synopsis: A woman with secrets to hide desperately tries to avoid mob justice in postwar Copenhagen in May el-Toukhy’s bracing third feature.

films.title: YAGA
films.genre: Adaptation / Mystery + Thriller / Drama / Canadian
films.synopsis: Starring Canadians Hudson Williams, Noah Reid, and Carrie-Anne Moss, this adaptation of Kat Sandler’s award-winning play unfurls the truth behind a mysterious disappearance in a small coastal town.

films.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.genre: Drama / Action + Adventure / Crime / Black + African Diaspora
films.synopsis: Oscar winner Mahershala Ali (TIFF ’18 People’s Choice Award winner Green Book) stars as a devout Muslim, loving family man, and contract killer in this audaciously inventive Texas-set action thriller from writer-director Bassam Tariq (Mogul Mowgli).

films.title: Zjili: A Story of Sisterhood and The Burdens of Excess
films.genre: Directed by Women / First Feature / Black + African Diaspora / Drama
films.synopsis: In their poignant debut feature, co-directors Christine Boateng and Hajara Musah Chambas depict the journey of three Ghanaian women eking out a living as kayayei or porters in the trenches of the world’s largest secondhand clothing market.
